meals.title: Every meal on the marketplace
meals.subtitle: Forty dishes from the kitchens that deliver to households, with the energy and protein figure on every card.
meals.searchPlaceholder: A dish, a kitchen, a cuisine
meals.allLoaded: That is every meal that matches.
meals.emptyBody: Widen a range, remove an allergen exclusion, or clear the filters to see the whole marketplace.

filters.excludeAllergensHint: Meals declaring any allergen you select here are removed from the results.
filters.rangesHint: Leave an end blank to leave it open.

meal.notFoundTitle: That meal is not on the marketplace
meal.notFoundBody: It may have been withdrawn, or the link may be wrong. Browse the catalogue to find another.
meal.imageLabel: Illustration standing in for a photograph of {{meal}}
meal.ingredientsBody: The kitchen publishes the declared allergens and the full nutrient composition for this dish. The ingredient list itself is not part of the public meal record, so it is not shown rather than guessed at.
meal.ingredientsContract: A future GET /api/v1/marketplace/meals/{meal} should return the ingredient quantities the figures were computed from.
meal.allergensDeclared: This dish declares the following allergens.
meal.allergensNone: The kitchen declares no allergens in this dish.
meal.availabilityNone: This kitchen has not published an availability window for this dish.
meal.subscriptionEligible: Can be part of a subscription
meal.b2bNoPrice: Business rates depend on volume, specification and delivery pattern, and are agreed per organisation. No business price is published here.
meal.addedToBasket: Added. Your basket now holds {{items}} items.
meal.basketSignIn: Sign in to start a basket
meal.actionErrorBody: Nothing was changed. Try again, and if it keeps failing the kitchen may have withdrawn the dish while this page was open.
meal.planSignIn: Sign in to plan this meal
meal.noPlanTitle: You do not have a plan yet
meal.noPlanBody: Adding a meal to a plan needs a plan to add it to. The planner and the setup questions that produce one are built in a later wave; until then you can browse the subscription plans or go to your home screen.
meal.replaceMeal: Replace a meal in my plan
meal.replaceTitle: Replacing a meal happens in the planner
meal.replaceBody: Swapping one entry for another compares the nutrition, the cost and the allergens of both, which only the planner can do. That screen is built in a later wave.
meal.quotationTitle: Bulk quotations go through a business account
meal.quotationBody: A quotation is priced against your organisation — volume, specification, sites and delivery pattern — so it starts with a business account rather than a published rate.

macros.title: Macronutrients
macros.ringValue: {{grams}} g, {{kilocalories}} kcal, {{percentage}}% of the energy in this serving — {{verdict}}
macros.referenceBody: The bands are the acceptable macronutrient distribution ranges for adults published by the Institute of Medicine. They describe a population, not you: a dish outside a band is not a bad dish, and a plan built around your own target may sit outside one deliberately.
macros.referenceCitation: Institute of Medicine. Dietary Reference Intakes for Energy, Carbohydrate, Fibre, Fat, Fatty Acids, Cholesterol, Protein and Amino Acids. National Academies Press, 2005.

facts.title: Nutrition facts
facts.per100gUnavailable: A per-100 g comparison needs a known mass for the serving, and this dish does not publish one.
facts.caption: Nutrition facts, {{basis}}
facts.syntheticNote: Synthetic prototype data. These figures describe no real product.

plans.title: Subscription plans
plans.subtitle: Eight plans from four kitchens, each with calorie bands, duration options and a from-price.
plans.compareHint: Select up to three plans, then open the comparison.
plans.compareFull: Three plans is the most that fits side by side. Deselect one to add another.
plans.emptyBody: Try another category, or clear the filters to see every plan.

compare.title: Compare plans
compare.subtitle: The same figures for each plan, side by side. Columns are equal — nothing here is presented as the recommended choice.
compare.caption: Subscription plans compared
compare.emptyBody: Choose two or three plans on the plan catalogue and the comparison fills in.
compare.macroCaveat: Macro figures are ranges, not point values: a plan that rotates across a season of menus has no single true protein figure, and stating one would be false precision.

plan.notFoundTitle: That plan is not on the marketplace
plan.notFoundBody: It may have been withdrawn, or the link may be wrong. Browse the catalogue to find another.
plan.imageLabel: Illustration standing in for a photograph of {{plan}}
plan.variantsBody: Each band is what a day is built to land inside. Pick the one nearest your target.
plan.macrosBody: Ranges rather than point values, because the menu rotates. Every figure moves with the band you choose.
plan.durationsBody: The weekly price is the same in every option; the discount is what the longer commitment earns.
plan.sampleMenuBody: Five dishes drawn from this kitchen's current menu. Synthetic data — an actual week rotates.
plan.sampleMenuEmpty: This plan has not published a sample menu.
plan.deliveryBody: Which weekdays a plan is delivered on is a real constraint — some kitchens run alternate days, and the office plan never delivers at a weekend.
plan.deliveryUnpublished: The public plan record does not carry that list, so it is not shown here rather than guessed at. It is confirmed when the subscription is configured, and a start date outside the kitchen's days moves to the next available one.
plan.deliveryUnpublishedShort: Confirmed at configuration; not published on the plan
plan.dietitianBody: Every plan is presented with a consultation, because a plan bought off a catalogue cannot know about a medical condition, a medication or a pregnancy. The consultation is where a qualified professional adjusts the band and records any restriction.
plan.priceBothUnits: Both a weekly and a daily figure are shown so the same plan cannot look cheaper in one place than another.

diet.notFoundTitle: That diet category does not exist
diet.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong. Browse the marketplace to find the way of eating you are after.
diet.title: {{diet}}
diet.countsLabel: {{meals}} meals and {{plans}} plans in this category
diet.suitabilityTitle: Who this suits, and who it does not
diet.suitabilityBody: A diet category is a preference filter. It is not a medical restriction, it is not screened for a medical condition, and selecting it does not remove an allergen — allergens are excluded separately, and an allergy or a dietitian-enforced restriction always overrides a preference.
diet.mealsBody: Every dish the kitchens classify this way, with its energy and protein figure.
diet.mealsEmptyTitle: No meals are classified this way yet
diet.mealsEmptyBody: The kitchens on the marketplace have not classified a dish under this category.
diet.plansBody: Subscription plans built around this way of eating.
diet.plansEmptyTitle: No plans in this category yet
diet.plansEmptyBody: No kitchen currently publishes a subscription plan under this category.

tools.calorieSubtitle: An energy estimate from published equations, with the method named and the arithmetic shown. No account, and nothing is stored.
tools.macroSubtitle: The same energy estimate, split into protein, carbohydrate and fat grams — and, as a secondary view, percentages and calories.
tools.sexHelp: The published equations take one of two constants here. This selects a constant in an equation and nothing else — it is not a question about gender identity, and it is not stored.
tools.bodyFatHelp: Answer this only if you have a measurement you trust. With it the estimate uses a lean-mass equation instead of a height-and-age one; a guess makes the result worse, not better.

activityHint.sedentary: Desk work and little deliberate exercise.
activityHint.lightly_active: Light exercise one to three days a week.
activityHint.moderately_active: Moderate exercise three to five days a week.
activityHint.very_active: Hard exercise six or seven days a week.
activityHint.extra_active: Physical job, or training twice a day.

tools.dietHint: A diet preference changes how the energy figure is split across the three macronutrients. It does not change the energy figure itself.
tools.maintenanceBody: What the equations estimate you use in a day at this activity level, before any goal adjustment.
tools.targetBody: The maintenance figure after the goal and pace adjustment, and after a published safety floor.
tools.toleranceBody: A day inside this band counts as on target. A single number would report normal variation as a failure.
tools.methodBody: Named rather than hidden, so the arithmetic can be checked instead of trusted.
tools.prototypeBody: This is a prototype. The equations are published and cited; the implementation has not been reviewed by a clinician, and nothing you type here is stored or sent anywhere.
tools.reviewBody: Some of what you entered puts the result outside the range these general-population equations are reliable over.
tools.macrosBody: Grams first. Percentages and calories are the secondary view, because a gram figure is what you can actually eat to.
tools.nextBody: Creating an account keeps the figure, applies your restrictions and fills a week against it. A registered dietitian can review it and set their own.
tools.incompleteTitle: A few answers are still missing
tools.incompleteBody: Fill in your age, height and weight and the estimate appears here.
tools.errorTitle: That estimate could not be worked out
